# Branch rows (Mundelein - Libertyville - Lake Bluff connections) left out: the branch trains are in the branch table (page 9).
# 436: "does not run during Daylight Saving Time" (left out). 440 (from Milwaukee: the Skokie Valley table times it to Edison Court) and 608 ("from Milwaukee during Daylight
# Saving Time", Sat. only; no times beyond North Chicago Junction printed) are flagged F (from Milwaukee); 516 is flagged H ("from Winthrop Harbor during Daylight Saving Time";
# no times beyond North Chicago Junction). 602, 604, 610, 612 start at Highwood. 210 (Waukegan 10th Street via the Skokie Valley Route) is in the Mundelein table.
# 612: Lincoln Avenue and Beech Street both read 5.16. 554 - 574, 522 - 542: one hour apart (checked against the scan row by row).
